title: Maximum Value at a Given Index in a Bounded Array
goal: Maximize one array position under positive-value, adjacent-difference, and total-sum limits.
strategy: For a candidate peak, the cheapest sides descend by one down to a floor of one. Compute their arithmetic-series sums and binary search the greatest affordable peak.
